description: Swift class AppLockManager managing app lock state with biometric authentication, including locking and unlocking methods, with comments indicating usage for app security features.

classes.name: AppLockManager
classes.description: A singleton class managing the app's lock state and biometric authentication to secure app content.

methods.name: lock()
methods.description: Locks the app UI until user authentication.

methods.name: unlockWithoutPrompt()
methods.description: Unlocks the app UI without prompting for credentials, used after logout.

methods.name: unlock()
methods.description: Attempts to unlock the app using biometric authentication asynchronously.

methods.name: lockAndRequireAuthIfNeeded()
methods.description: Locks the app and requests authentication upon returning to foreground, if enabled.
